title: Rule 12 - Statement and Undertaking Regarding Foreign Applications (Form 3)
section_title: Rule 12 - Statement and Undertaking Regarding Foreign Applications (Form 3)
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
publisher: CGPDTM, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
content: Statement and undertaking under section 8 shall be filed within six months from the date of filing the application. The applicant shall periodically update the Controller regarding corresponding foreign status.

title: Rule 13 - Specifications and Biological Material Deposit
section_title: Rule 13 - Specifications and Biological Material Deposit
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
publisher: CGPDTM, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
content: Rule 13(8) provides that where biological material is used in an invention and is not available to the public, the applicant shall deposit the material with an International Depository Authority under the Budapest Treaty on or before the date of filing.

title: Rule 24B - Request for Examination (Form 18)
section_title: Rule 24B - Request for Examination (Form 18)
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
publisher: CGPDTM, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
content: A request for examination under section 11B shall be made in Form 18 within thirty-one months from the date of priority of the application or from the date of filing of the application, whichever is earlier.

title: Rule 24C - Expedited Examination of Applications (Form 18A)
section_title: Rule 24C - Expedited Examination of Applications (Form 18A)
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
publisher: CGPDTM, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
content: An applicant may file a request for expedited examination in Form 18A on grounds including: applicant is a startup, small entity, female applicant, government department, or applicant eligible under bilateral Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) programs.

title: Rule 55 - Opposition to Grant of Patent (Pre-Grant)
section_title: Rule 55 - Opposition to Grant of Patent (Pre-Grant)
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
publisher: CGPDTM, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
content: Representation for opposition under section 25(1) shall be filed in Form 7A at the appropriate office with a statement and evidence. No fee is payable for pre-grant opposition under Section 25(1).

title: Rule 131 - Form and Manner in which Statements Required under Section 146(2) to be Furnished (Form 27)
section_title: Rule 131 - Form and Manner in which Statements Required under Section 146(2) to be Furnished (Form 27)
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
publisher: CGPDTM, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
content: The statements which shall be supplied by every patentee and every licensee under subsection (2) of section 146 shall be in Form 27 in respect of every financial year, furnishing whether the patent is worked commercially in India.
